query: SELECT hl.region, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hp.gender = 'M' AND hp.is_in_population = true THEN hp.id END) AS male_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hp.is_in_population = true THEN hp.id END) AS total_count, ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hp.gender = 'M' AND hp.is_in_population = true THEN hp.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hp.is_in_population = true THEN hp.id END)), 2) AS male_percentage FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND hp.is_in_population = true AND hl.region IS NOT NULL AND Trim( hl.region ) != '' GROUP BY hl.region ORDER BY hl.region LIMIT 1200
